text.en:
The National Quincentennial Committee. A steering
committee for the commemoration of the quincentennial of the arrival of Ferdinand
Magellan in the Philippines, the victory of Lapu-Lapu in the Battle of Mactan, and
other historic events from 1519 to 1522 is hereby created, to be known as the
National Quincentennial Committee.

Functions. The Committee shall take charge of the preparations
for the commemoration, and for this purpose, shall have the following functions:
(a) Undertake the overall study, conceptualization, and implementation of
programs and projects relevant to the commemoration and which makes
use of history, culture, and media for the purpose of reinvigorating the
spirit of national unity and international comity;
(b) Act as the principal coordinator for all activities related to the
quincentennial commemoration, including those intended to increase
awareness of the quincentennial among Filipinos;
(c) Serve as the clearing house for the preparation and dissemination of all
information about the plans and activities for the quincentennial of
Magellan's arrival and its associated events;
(d) Constitute working groups which shall undertake the implementation of the
programs and projects;
(e) Prioritize the refurbishment of historical sites and structures associated
with the quincentennial;
(f) Receive donations for the purpose of achieving the objectives of this
Order, subject to applicable laws, rules and regulations, and
(g) Call upon any government agency or instrumentality, and invite private
individuals and organizations, including overseas or international entities,
to assist in the performance of its functions.

Secretariat. The Committee shall be provided with technical and
administrative staff support by a Secretariat to be constituted by the NHCP.

Funding. The Committee shall be funded with an initial budget
of Ten Million Pesos (R10,000,000.00) to be drawn from the Contingent Fund.
Appropriations for succeeding years shall be incorporated in the budget proposal of

Comprehensive Plan. The Committee shall prepare, for
approval of the President, a Comprehensive Plan for the Quincentennial
Commemoration within six (6) months from the effectivity of this Order.

Sunset Provision. The Committee shall be an ad hoc body and
its existence shall terminate on September 2022.

Separability. If any section or part of this Order is held
unconstitutional or invalid, the other sections or provisions not otherwise affected
shall remain in full force or effect.

Repeal. All executive issuances inconsistent with this Order are
hereby repealed or amended accordingly.

Effectivity. This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE, in the City of Manila, this 8th day of May
Lord, Two Thousand and Eighteen.
